time_basis.elapsed_us: Integer microseconds since the first exported joined sample; preserves intervals only.
time_basis.note: Original join used GPS week/ms epoch arithmetic without the GPS-to-UTC leap-second subtraction. The relative timeline preserves that historical join. UTC-equivalent values relabel both clocks without claiming a newly estimated physical offset.

extraction.phase_policy: first_10_laps includes both clean-window endpoints; post_intervention is after the clean end through flight end; remaining joined samples are off_mission.
extraction.exported_selection: All joined flight samples, before stability/acceleration/speed-bin selection; no fit-dependent row selection.

columns.esc_sum_power_w: sum of four decoded ESC voltage*current values in watts; electrical scale/branch interpretation is not established by this derived file
columns.mechanical_rpm: median of four ESC mechanical RPM values after raw*10/21 conversion
columns.match_dt_s: absolute nearest-neighbor timestamp difference in seconds

limitations: Derived telemetry replay cannot independently audit the private raw decoder, clock estimation or phase identification.
Ground speed and estimated attitude/velocity are not wind-free airspeed or measured thrust.
No propeller diameter or takeoff mass is measured by this CSV; reproduction configuration is an explicit assumption.
July 21 filtering and clock offset were developed after observing this flight, not prospectively blinded.
